title: add jsonschema strict response_format with improved error reporting and OpenAI compatibility
author: Maya Chen
release_notes: Add `response_format: json_schema` strict mode and improved validation error reporting. Backwards-compatible default behavior preserved; OpenAI-compat mapping added for `response_format` and `response_format_options`. Users can enable strict validation to receive structured error payloads and guidance for fixing outputs.
description: Motivation: Add a strict JSON Schema response_format that enforces model output shapes at the API layer and returns structured, machine-readable validation errors for downstream handling. This improves reliability for tool/function-calling and structured output use-cases and aligns Redwood's API with OpenAI-compatible behavior for schema-based responses. Changes: 1) Introduce `response_format: {type: "json_schema", strict: true|false, schema: <json-schema>}` parsing and runtime enforcement in the request handler. 2) Validation pipeline that runs post-generation against the provided JSON Schema and emits a canonical `response_format_error` object with path, expected type, and a short fix suggestion. 3) OpenAI compatibility shim that maps `response_format: "json_schema"` and `response_format_options` to Redwood's format and preserves streaming behavior. 4) Add tests, docs, and examples for common schemas and function-calling integration. Backwards compatibility: default strict=false preserves existing permissive behavior; we added explicit fields and migration notes in docs. Testing & CI: unit tests for validator, integration tests exercising streaming + schema enforcement, and E2E tests for Python/TS SDKs. Rollout plan: feature flagged by `enable_jsonschema_strict` with gradual rollout to beta orgs, preserve fallbacks to non-strict mode on validation failures. See linked Linear items for scope and rollout schedule. Checklist: [x] Handler parsing and validation pipeline implemented [x] Canonical error payload defined [x] OpenAI compat shim added [x] Unit/integration tests [x] Docs and examples updated [x] Feature flag + rollout plan

review_comments: Arjun Patel: Left a few nits on error message wording; can we include a short "fix" suggestion in the canonical error so SDKs can present actionable UI?
Maya Chen (author): Reply: Added `fix_suggestion` to the payload and updated tests. PTAL.

Lena Rodriguez: Concern about streaming - if the model emits partial invalid JSON the validator will currently reject; suggest we accept streaming tokens and validate only after EOS or when user requests `validate_partial: true`.
Maya Chen (author): Reply: Implemented streaming-friendly collector that runs validation at EOS by default and added `validate_partial` opt-in flag. Added integration tests covering both flows.
Kofi Mensah: Tests look thorough. Two small comments on naming in the OpenAI shim to keep parity with OpenAI semantics.
Maya Chen (author): Reply: renamed shim fields to match OpenAI keys and updated docs.
merge_commit_message:
squash: add jsonschema strict response_format + openai compat

Adds strict validation pipeline, canonical error payloads, and OpenAI-compat shim for schema-based response_format. Includes tests and docs.
merge_notes: Feature gated behind `enable_jsonschema_strict`. Rolling out to 10% of orgs initially. Monitor `response_format_error` metric and validation failure rate.
post_merge_actions: Enable feature flag for internal beta orgs
Add migration note to release announcement
